Real Yosys logs captured 2026-11-09 with YoWASP Yosys 0.70 (pip yowasp-yosys), command:
  yowasp-yosys -p "read_verilog X.v; hierarchy -check -top top; synth -top top"
Plain `synth`, not `synth_fabulous`: front-end (read_verilog / hierarchy) messages are the same, back-end ones may differ.
These are NOT nextpnr logs; nextpnr wording remains unverified.
